usage_note: For one camera only, synchronization may explicitly be not-applicable-single-camera. Evaluate --scope raw-capture to collect new calibration; --scope corrected requires new_lens_calibration. Sensor supply/DOVDD rail, interface signal level and FPGA bank voltage/IOSTANDARD are different facts. For a declared non-3.3-V DVP signal level, add verification.io_level_compatibility=true and electrical.io_compatibility_evidence from an explicit device/adapter/bank compatibility review; verification.electrical is still required. This tool does not decide device voltage thresholds. All verification declarations must refer to the selected candidate/scope.
